question: What is the algorithm used to create word embeddings?
title: Shared Task: Lexical Semantic Change Detection in German
answer_rationale: The document states that most teams use 'skip-gram with negative sampling (SGNS)' based on BIBREF13 to learn semantic spaces, as mentioned in Text 21 and further elaborated in Text 24, Text 26, Text 28, Text 30, Text 32, Text 34, Text 36, Text 38, Text 40, Text 42, and Text 44. This is the predominant algorithm used for creating word embeddings in the context of this shared task.
